decisions.reason: A hearty bread close to the core assortment uses existing craft skills and production capacity at low incremental cost, so with no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations management has little reason to start problemistic search and keeps it.

The historic mill tour extends the firm's existing hospitality and event facilities and supports the heritage brand, and slack in those facilities lets the firm carry it while its results remain uncertain.
A sweet pastry fits the established confectionery line and is cheap to sustain, so in the absence of reported underperformance it stays in the range.
